evals.prompt: 我想幫這個 todo API 加上使用者認證，但不確定要用 JWT 還是 session，也不確定要不要分 role。幫我想一下怎麼做比較好，然後拆成可以執行的工作項目。
evals.expected_output: Should explore JWT vs session trade-offs, ask about role requirements, then produce a work breakdown with PR groups and OpenSpec changes.

assertions.text: Uses AskUserQuestion tool at least once to clarify requirements
Discusses trade-offs between at least 2 auth approaches (JWT vs session, or similar)
Produces a work breakdown showing PR groups with changes listed under each
Does NOT write any application code (no .js/.ts files modified)

evals.prompt: 我想加一個 user 的概念，讓每個 todo 屬於某個 user。然後有些 user 是 admin 可以看到所有人的 todo。
evals.expected_output: Should challenge the vague term 'user' — is it an account owner, a tenant, an API consumer? Should probe 'admin' — is this RBAC or just a boolean flag? Should sharpen terminology before jumping to implementation.

assertions.text: Challenges or questions the meaning of 'user' or 'admin' before accepting the terms at face value
Uses AskUserQuestion tool to clarify the domain model
Does NOT write any application code
